patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — PrestaShop and Squarespace share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Frame: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — PrestaShop and Squarespace share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.. Choose PrestaShop only if your buying job matches “Open-source PHP commerce — Classic free; Hosted from ~$26/mo annual (€24 excl. VAT) with 1” rather than Squarespace's shape. Choose Squarespace only if your buying job matches “Design-led website builder with commerce — Basic $16, Core $23, Plus $39, Advanced $99/mo ” rather than PrestaShop's shape. Workflow advantage: PrestaShop leans catalog-management; Squarespace leans checkout-conversion, website-builder-commerce. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — PrestaShop and Squarespace share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: PrestaShop is Open-source PHP commerce — Classic free; Hosted from ~$26/mo annual (€24 excl. VAT) with 14-day trial; Enterprise quote. WooCommerce keeps t; Squarespace is Design-led website builder with commerce — Basic $16, Core $23, Plus $39, Advanced $99/mo annual (US 2026 tiles); platform transaction fees .
- Company-size focus: PrestaShop (small-business, mid-market) vs Squarespace (solo, micro, small-business).
- Workflow coverage skew: PrestaShop-leaning catalog-management vs Squarespace-leaning checkout-conversion, website-builder-commerce.
- Researched limits: PrestaShop — Classic TCO (hosting, modules, agency) is not $0 even when the license is free; Squarespace — Platform transaction fees on lower tiers can exceed the subscription savings at volume.

Limitations — PrestaShop: Classic TCO (hosting, modules, agency) is not $0 even when the license is free; POS / omnichannel is module-dependent, not a native retail bundle; Squarespace: Platform transaction fees on lower tiers can exceed the subscription savings at volume; Catalog and B2B depth trail commerce-first platforms.

Poor-fit cases: PrestaShop is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Classic TCO (hosting, modules, agency) is not $0 even when the license is free · Squarespace is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Platform transaction fees on lower tiers can exceed the subscription savings at volume · Avoid PrestaShop if you actually need Squarespace's motion (Design-led website builder with commerce — Basic $16, Core $23, Plus $39, Advanc)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
